notes.title: Rise for the Fight - Beta Snippet 6 Patch 2 Out Now
notes.notes:
Good morning!

Today's Patch Update consists of a Sandbox Update. Some were mostly left unchanged, However, all weapons that had no recoil have had a recoil update applied, and all guns had a Damage Falloff update applied. Here are the changes made to the guns: 



Weapon Categories: 

- Pistols: CSP, P13, SP10

- Shotguns: Blunderbuss, DBS, DSG4, SG3

- SMGS: FRAYR-G1, SMG-P1

- LMGs: HMG22

- Assault: HAM-GUN

- Marksman: DMR10

- Snipers: SR76





Damage Falloff values: 

- Pistols: 6 meters

- Shotguns: 7.5 meters

- SMGs / LMGs: 10 meters

- Assault / Marksman: 15 meters

- Snipers: 20 meters





Weapon Recoil Explanation: 

All weapons now have recoil. Before, it was select weapons, those being the P13, HMG22, SR76, and Blunderbuss. Now, all weapons have Recoil. The recoil system works by having the guns be more difficult when not aiming, and more easily controlled when aiming. All guns have a similar recoil value, but some have slightly higher values than others, making them a skillful weapon to use. A good example of this is the SR76. While being difficult to control all around, once mastered, it becomes a deadly weapon in the right hands.

While on the topic of the SR76, I have increased its base damage from 100 to 200, so it's a one-hit-kill anywhere you shoot at on your enemies, while maintaining its challenging recoil.



With that said, feel free experiment, practice, and work towards mastering your aim with the new update. 

Good luck! 
-Reece

notes.title: Rise for the Fight - Moshpit Overhaul Update Preview
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

Today, I am covering a pretty big topic: Moshpit.

Moshpit was a singleplayer game mode where the goal is to survive as many rounds as possible without dying. The zombies were easy to kill. As a matter of fact, they were too easy to kill. Their stats were only updated on Rounds 5, 10, and 20, and they couldn't navigate higher elevated parts of the map, making it easy to camp and get kills.

So today, I am announcing an overhaul that's been in the works for Moshpit. 

Here's what I changed. Starting off with the zombies, 

I made them start off with the usual 100 HP and 5 Movement speed. However, each round, they get 20 additional health, a damage increase of 5 HP each round until their damage is 50, and a speed increase of 0.75 each round until their movement speed is 10. Additionally, their navigation across the maps have improved. They can now climb higher spots they could not previously climb, and jump over edges to reach the player. On top of that, they can now redirect to another player if they are shot enough times by another player, or if the player they targeted has died.

Next, for the Survivors, With the changes made to the zombies, your Upgrade Points can now be used to indefinitely upgrade your gun's stats. There is no longer a limit, which was 10. This only applies to Moshpit and Decapit. When you die, if you are able to respawn, the gun that is equipped when you respawn will have a damage increase of either 10 Damage Points times the amount of rounds you survive, or 5 Damage Points per pellet times the amount of rounds you survive. 

You'll also notice a new stat called "REVIVES AVAILABLE" 
That's because there is a new vending machine called "AFTERLIFE REVIVAL". This machine will cost 10,000 Cash to purchase in both Moshpit and Decapit, and will grant you the following:

- 1 Respawn Token (which is used as soon as you respawn. This is stackable.)
- 7500 Cash instead of 100 Cash.
- Your equipped gun at the time of purchase (Note that you will lose all your upgrades, but will be compensated in upgrade points.)
- 10 Upgrade Points

If you don't purchase from this machine, you risk dying and ending the game, as now if no player object is active with at least 1 Respawn Token, the game will end automatically, and you'll be brought back to the main menu.

While on the topic of Vending Machines, Gunboost will now add additional damage to your gun, alongside Rate of Fire, and Magazine Capacity. This remains stackable. Gungen now has no limit to purchases, however, Boosters now have a limit of 3 purchases. Once that is met, you can no longer purchase from that vending machine.

Finally, with all of these changes. I have now made Moshpit CO-OP! You now have the option to play solo or with up to 4 Players! With this change, the menu UI has also changed. The "Singleplayer" button has been changed to "1P / CO-OP". The UI for the Moshpit lobby has also seen a major change to its' style and layout, resembling more of the main menu elements.



There is plenty more where that came from. To try this update, go to the game's Properties, and change Beta Participation to "playtest".

Enjoy!
-Reece

notes.title: Rise for the Fight - New Year, New Progress Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Reece here.



Holy cow, what a year 2024 has been. Lots of stuff has happened since then. I started working 2 jobs, took a few breaks, and spent some good time with my friends and family.

And now, it's time to get back to work, and share a progress update with you guys.



While I've been away, I've been cooking. Refining assets, fixing bugs, and much more.



To start off, Changes to Progression. Starting in Beta Snippet 5, the XP Requirements for each rank will be changed. 

Here's what the new requirements will be: 

- Recruit to Private: 500 -> 2,500

- Private to Corporal: 1,000 -> 7,500

- Corporal to Captain: 2,500 -> 15,000

- Captain to Sargeant: 5,000 -> 25,000

- Sargeant to Sargeant Major: 10,000 -> 40,000

- Sargeant Major to Commander: 25,000 -> 80,000

- Commander to Commander Major: 50,000 -> 150,000

- Commander Major to Colonel: 100,000 -> 250,000

- Colonel to Lt. Colonel: 250,000 -> 375,000

- Lt. Colonel to General: 500,000 -> 500,000

- General to General Major: 750,000 -> 750,000

- General Major to Honor Guard: 1,000,000 -> 1,000,000

- Honor Guard to Veteran: 1,500,000 -> 1,500,000

However, with these changes, the XP that will be given to players will be doubled for both Base XP and Double XP. I will have more details on that once Beta Snippet 5 is out.



Second,  I have been working on refining some of the assets in my game. For example: I've remodeled the SG3 Shotgun, changed the Reloading Sounds of the P13 Pistol and SR76 Sniper, and Remade the map Plaza, just to name a few.



Third, I've made a major change to all the sandbox items with the help of a close friend of mine, who happens to know a thing or two about guns in games. Most, if not, all the guns in the sandbox feel significantly quicker than before and have a quicker time-to-kill thanks to their significant buffs made.



As mentioned previously, I will have more details on everything once Beta Snippet 5 comes out.



Well, that sums up everything for this Progress Update. If you would like to take a peek at what has been changed, feel free to click on the link below: 

[previewyoutube=I78w57dXfac;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










Happy New Years! 
-Reece

notes.title: Rise for the Fight - Beta Snippets and Pricing Update
notes.notes:
Good morning, everyone.

I would like to talk about the new Beta Snippets with Rise for the Fight, and give an update on the pricing change I previously made.

Starting with the pricing changes, I previously stated that I would be changing the price from Free to $2.99. This will no longer be in effect as of today. There are two reasons for why I am making this change:

- I realize if I want to build a community and get feedback for my game, I should keep the game free and accessible to everyone. If I want to acquire income to help support the game, I can look into alternative methods.
- Steam only allows the change once per the game's life cycle, and it CANNOT be reverted. 

With that said, the price will remain free. 

As for the beta snippets, these are made to progressively work towards getting the game into the beta stage. These "Snippets" can be seen as Pre-Beta builds, and will have more added to it over time until the beta is ready.

You can view the full Beta Snippet log here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1871970/view/4199124769096072163?l=english




Thank you for reading. See you in the fight!
-Reece

notes.title: Rise for the Fight Alpha 1.8 Patch 8 Out Now
notes.notes:
Progress!

ALPHA BUILD 1.8 PATCH 8 CHANGELOG:

ADDITIONS AND ADJUSTMENTS:
- Added NEW Ranking System / You can now progress through the game by killing, and winning games. There are a total of 12 Ranks, and the first 4 will over time give you full access to the character customization. Max Rank reward in the works.
- Reset Everyone's Character customization for the new Progression System. You will still be able to select Shirt Color and Death Sound by default, but you will need to level up to access all customization options.



PROGRESSION SYSTEM DETAILS:
- Customization Options are earned by ranking up. 
- Getting to Recruit unlocks Facial Expressions.
- Getting to Private unlocks Glove Colors.
- Getting to Corporal unlocks Outerwear.
- Getting to Sergeant unlocks Hat Selection. 
- Getting to Max rank will eventually unlock a special cosmetic item.

- You can progress by killing players, zombies in Moshpit, or by winning multiplayer games.
- Zombies in Moshpit will give you 5 XP per kill.
- Players in Multiplayer will give you 10 XP per kill.
- Players in Surge while controlling the zone will give you 20 XP per kill.
- Completing Multiplayer Matches will give you 50 XP per match.
- Winning Multiplayer Matches will give you 150 XP per match.
- Double XP, which is not yet implemented, will double the XP you get when active.

notes.title: Rise for the Fight Alpha 1.8 Patch 4 Out Now
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

Thank you for sticking around. To show my appreciation, I have re-enabled the ability to unlock the Loyalty achievement. This achievement will be unlockable until the game is fully ready for release. After release, you can unlock the achievement by participating in the beta branch builds.

With that said, here is the changelog for the 1.8 Patch 4 update:

ADDITIONS AND ADJUSTMENTS:

- Added NEW Map: Legacy / Originally planned to be a RiseVR exclusive, this map is inspired by Zealot from Halo Reach.
- Added a NEW Sound when your gun tier upgrades in Gun Cycle.
- When you die in Gun Cycle, you will keep whatever previous gun you were on when you die.
- Added NEW Custom Matches UI! The Singleplayer UI will be receiving the same treatment soon.
- Increasd Juggeernaut Health from 200 to 300.
- Re-enabled Matchmaking! However, Custom Matches might still be faster to find games. Matchmaking can have up to 5 players instead of 4.
- Updated the Butcherer achievement so it's easier to obtain. Instead of needing 500 kills, you will now need to get a kill streak of 10 or higher (get the Killing Machine streak or higher) to unlock the achievement.
- Trade kills now count! Each player will now get 1 Kill Point when trade killing.


SANDBOX CHANGES:
- Changed HMG22 Damage from 4 to 5.
- Decreased HP6 Rate of Fire from 2.5 to 2.
- Disabled HP6 in Gun Party.
- Changed Starting Weapon in Juggernaut from the SG3 Shotgun to the HAM-GUN.
- Increased SP10 Pellet Count from 2 to 3.
- Increased SP10 Bullet Spread from 6% to 7%.
- Changed MAR5 firing Sound to have the current sound and a new firing sound combined.


BUG FIXES:
- Disabled the P13 equipping before the start of a Pandemic match.
- Fixed Powerup Pickups only working for the host of the custom match.

See you in the fight. 
-Reece

notes.title: Rise for the Fight Update 1.8 Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

Sorry for the late update. I have been really busy with work, and haven't had the motivation to work on my game. I hope to get the game into a more stable state in the upcoming future, and to get a bigger playerbase to allow multiplayer to be more playable.

I also got an Oculus Quest 2 recently, and have been thinking about making a VR version of Rise for the Fight. I'll let you know what I decide.

With that said, here is the changelog for the current update!



ALPHA BUILD 1.8 RELEASE CHANGELOG:


ADDITIONS AND ADJUSTMENTS:

- Changed HP6 Firing Animation duration from 0.3s to 0.25s.
- Added NEW Feature: Powerups / At the start of the match, it will take 15 seconds to spawn a new powerup. Every 30 seconds after, a new powerup will spawn, giving the player who picks one up an advantage over the other. These are the current powerups:
	
	- Health Boost / This will give you 180 HP instead of 60 HP. Your health will not regenerate to 180 if you take damage with the powerup traits equipped.
	- Speed Boost / This will give you a 2x boost in Walk Speed, Run Speed, and a 1.5x boost in Jump Height for 10s.
	- Bottoms Up / This will give you infinite ammo for 15s. when this expires, you will get max ammo reserves
	
	- (COMING LATER...) Quick Escape / This will teleport you where your gun shoots, and will add 50 extra bullets to your ammo reserves. Make sure to press the "Interact" button when you shoot to teleport.

	
If you are infected, or a juggernaut, you will not be able to pick up a powerup.





SANDBOX CHANGES:

- Decreased BMR21 Rate Of Fire from 7 to 6.


- Increased SP10 Rate of Fire from 2.5 to 3.
- Decreased SP10 Damage from 20 to 10.
- Decreased SP10 Pellet Count from 3 to 2.


- Decreased HP6 Rate of Fire from 3.5 to 2.5.

If you come across any issues with this update, feel free to let me know here.

Have fun, and see you in the fight!
-Reece

notes.title: Rise for the Fight Alpha 1.7 Release Out Now (BIRTHDAY UPDATE)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.



Today, as of 9/14/2023, it is my birthday. To celebrate, I will be releasing a new update, and will soon be discounting the Glove Color Expansion Pack by 50%!

If approved, This discount will last until October 14, 2023.

This new update brings a new mode, and some other QOL improvements. 

Here is the full changelog of Alpha 1.7:

- Made the map Park a bit brighter so it's easier to navigate and see.
- Decreased the MAR5 Rifle animation duration.
- Added a NEW Mode: Tug of War. Progress through your Tug Bar by killing players. First to complete their Tug Bar wins.


Here's some more details on how the mode works:

- Each player will start out at 0% progress on the Tug Bar, and will have to try and kill other players to progress their Tug Bar.
- If you are at less than 70% progress with your Tug Bar, you will get 2 points per kill, and will lose 1 point on death.
- If you are at 70% progress or greater with your Tug Bar, you will get 1 point per kill, and will lose 2 points on death.
- If you make it to 20 Points on the Tug Bar (100% progress), you will win the game.
